# Tags Input

Create, navigate, and remove free-form tokens from one text field.

## Examples

### Skills

Create and remove free-form skill tags without losing input focus.

<ComponentExample component="tags-input" scenario="skills" title="Skills" description="Create and remove free-form skill tags without losing input focus." :index="0" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Comma</kbd> | Commit the current input as a tag. |
| <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> | Move between the input and existing tags. |
| <kbd>Backspace</kbd> / <kbd>Delete</kbd> | Move to or remove the current tag according to cursor state. |

## Accessibility

The labeled group keeps its text input native and names every removable tag action.
